title: Nourishing Norwegian Lamb Skillet
description: A hearty and comforting Norwegian dish featuring lamb, clotted cream, and vegetables, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Preheat the salt block vessel to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the lamb shoulder into thin strips and season with salt and black pepper.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in the preheated salt block vessel and cook the lamb strips until browned.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the vessel and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the vessel and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the clotted cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the lamb and vegetable mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
